import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { View, Text, ScrollView, StyleSheet } from 'react-native';
import { useFeeding } from '@/context/FeedingContext';
import Colors from '@/constants/Colors';
import Theme from '@/constants/Theme';
import Header from '@/components/layouts/Header';
import Card from '@/components/ui/Card';
import Counter from '@/components/ui/Counter';
import Button from '@/components/ui/Button';
import FeedingProgressIndicator from '@/components/ui/FeedingProgressIndicator';
import PawPrintBackground from '@/components/ui/PawPrintBackground';
import { formatHeader } from '@/utils/dateFormat';

export default function HomeScreen() {
  const { state, addFeeding, resetToday } = useFeeding();
  const [amount, setAmount] = useState(0.25);
  const [date, setDate] = useState('');

  // Update the date display
  useEffect(() => {
    setDate(formatHeader(new Date()));
  }, []);

  // Handle adding food
  const handleAddFood = () => {
    if (amount > 0) {
      addFeeding(amount);
      // Reset to 0.25 after adding
      setAmount(0.25);
    }
  };

  // Get the subtitle for the header
  const getSubtitle = () => {
    if (state.loading) return 'Loading...';
    if (!state.todayData) return date;
    
    const percentFed = Math.min(100, (state.todayData.amountFed / state.todayData.target) * 100);
    return `${Math.round(percentFed)}% of daily goal`;
  };

  return (
    <View style={styles.container}>
      <PawPrintBackground />
      
      <Header 
        title="Poppy's Food Tracker" 
        subtitle={getSubtitle()}
      />
      
      <ScrollView 
        style={styles.scrollView}
        contentContainerStyle={styles.contentContainer}
      >
        {state.loading ? (
          <Card>
            <Text style={styles.loadingText}>Loading Poppy's data...</Text>
          </Card>
        ) : state.todayData ? (
          <>
            <Card>
              <Text style={styles.sectionTitle}>Today's Progress</Text>
              <FeedingProgressIndicator 
                amountFed={state.todayData.amountFed} 
                targetAmount={state.todayData.target} 
              />
              
              <View style={styles.infoRow}>
                <Text style={styles.infoText}>
                  {state.todayData.amountFed.toFixed(2)} / {state.todayData.target.toFixed(2)} cups
                </Text>
              </View>
            </Card>
            
            <Card>
              <Text style={styles.sectionTitle}>Add Food</Text>
              <Text style={styles.instructionText}>
                How much food did you give Poppy?
              </Text>
              
              <Counter 
                value={amount} 
                onChange={setAmount} 
                min={0.25} 
                max={state.todayData.target} 
                step={0.25} 
              />
              
              <View style={styles.buttonContainer}>
                <Button 
                  title="Add Food" 
                  onPress={handleAddFood} 
                  variant="primary" 
                  size="large"
                  fullWidth
                />
              </View>
            </Card>

            <Card>
              <Text style={styles.sectionTitle}>Daily Summary</Text>
              <View style={styles.summaryContainer}>
                <View style={styles.summaryRow}>
                  <Text style={styles.summaryLabel}>Total Fed Today:</Text>
                  <Text style={styles.summaryValue}>
                    {state.todayData.amountFed.toFixed(2)} cups
                  </Text>
                </View>
                
                <View style={styles.summaryRow}>
                  <Text style={styles.summaryLabel}>Daily Target:</Text>
                  <Text style={styles.summaryValue}>
                    {state.todayData.target.toFixed(2)} cups
                  </Text>
                </View>
                
                <View style={styles.summaryRow}>
                  <Text style={styles.summaryLabel}>Remaining:</Text>
                  <Text style={[
                    styles.summaryValue,
                    state.todayData.amountFed >= state.todayData.target 
                      ? styles.targetMet 
                      : null
                  ]}>
                    {state.todayData.amountFed >= state.todayData.target 
                      ? 'Target met! 🎉' 
                      : `${(state.todayData.target - state.todayData.amountFed).toFixed(2)} cups`
                    }
                  </Text>
                </View>
              </View>
              
              <View style={styles.resetContainer}>
                <Button 
                  title="Reset Today's Count" 
                  onPress={resetToday} 
                  variant="outlined" 
                  size="small"
                />
              </View>
            </Card>
          </>
        ) : (
          <Card>
            <Text style={styles.errorText}>
              Could not load feeding data. Please try again.
            </Text>
          </Card>
        )}
      </ScrollView>
    </View>
  );
}

const styles = StyleSheet.create({
